post_actions.failed.defaultMessage: {action, select, favourite {お気に入り} boost {ブースト} bookmark {ブックマーク} mute {スレッドのミュート} vote {投票} other {リアクション}}を完了できませんでした。
post_actions.failed.description: The notice at the bottom of the page when the reader's favourite, boost, bookmark, emoji reaction or mute of a thread on a post (set or taken back), or their vote in a post's poll, got no answer from the server (the network), beside Try again. The post shows again what it showed before. action is which of them.

post_actions.retry.description: The action of a post's failed notice (a favourite, boost, bookmark, emoji reaction or vote, deleting, loading the edit history or the post to edit): it does the same again.

post_actions.deleted.description: The notice at the bottom of the page after the reader's post was deleted (Delete…); it is gone from every list and view.

post_actions.delete_failed.defaultMessage: 投稿の削除を完了できませんでした。
post_actions.delete_failed.description: The notice at the bottom of the page when deleting the reader's post (Delete… or Delete and redraft…) got no answer from the server (the network), beside Try again. The post stays, and a redraft's composer does not open.

post_actions.link_copied.defaultMessage: リンクをコピーしました
post_actions.link_copied.description: The notice at the bottom of the page after Copy link, or after Share on a device that cannot share, copied the link to the post.

post_actions.copy_failed.defaultMessage: リンクをコピーできませんでした。
post_actions.copy_failed.description: The notice at the bottom of the page when the browser refused to copy the link to the post (Copy link, or Share on a device that cannot share); it offers no Try again, since a refused clipboard refuses again.

post_actions.bookmarked.defaultMessage: 投稿をブックマークしました
post_actions.bookmarked.description: The notice at the bottom of the page after Bookmark in a post's more menu bookmarked it; the post is in Bookmarks.

post_actions.unbookmarked.defaultMessage: ブックマークを外しました
post_actions.unbookmarked.description: The notice at the bottom of the page after Remove bookmark in a post's more menu took the reader's bookmark of the post back; the post is no longer in Bookmarks.

post_actions.history_failed.defaultMessage: 編集履歴を読み込めませんでした。
post_actions.history_failed.description: The notice at the bottom of the page when an edited post's edit history did not load from the server, beside Try again, which loads it again.

post_actions.source_failed.defaultMessage: 編集する投稿を読み込めませんでした。
post_actions.source_failed.description: The notice at the bottom of the page when the reader's post did not load from the server to edit it (Edit), beside Try again; the composer does not open.

post_actions.approval_pending.description: The line over the reader's own reply that waits for the approval of the author of the post it replies to; only the reader sees the reply.

post_actions.approval_rejected.defaultMessage: 承認されませんでした
post_actions.approval_rejected.description: The line over the reader's own reply that the author of the post it replies to declined; only the reader sees it.

post_actions.boost_waits.description: The line over a post the reader boosted whose author approves boosts by hand, until the author does.
